title: Anti-Israel groups protest in New York City on Oct. 7 anniversary
seoTitle: New York City anti-Israel groups protest

tea.why: Protesters marked the third anniversary of the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas-led attack as a day of 'resistance' and accused Mayor Mamdani of 'betrayal'.
tea.want: Organizers called for 'resistance against imperialism,' NYU divestment from Israel, and the closure of its Tel Aviv campus.
tea.changed: Oct 7: Protesters gathered at Washington Square Park and outside City Hall, with students walking out at Columbia and NYU.

summary: Anti-Israel groups held protests across New York City on October 7, 2026, marking the third anniversary of the Hamas-led attack on Israel. Organizers, including Students for Justice in Palestine, Within Our Lifetime, and Pal-Awda, framed the date as an anniversary of Palestinian 'resistance' against 'imperialism.' Demonstrations occurred at Washington Square Park and outside City Hall, with students from New York University and Columbia University participating. Protesters demanded 'divestment' from Israel and the closure of NYU's Tel Aviv campus. Organizers also accused Mayor Zohran Mamdani of 'betraying' the Palestinian cause, citing his administration's policing of demonstrations and an antisemitism strategy.
organizers: Faculty and Staff for Justice in Palestine
demands: Closure of NYU's Tel Aviv campus
response: No official response reported in the sources.

crowd.text: hundreds across New York City, with more than 100 at Washington Square Park, according to nypost.com

updates.text: Anti-Israel groups planned a 'resistance' rally outside New York City Hall, accusing Mayor Mamdani of 'betrayal'.
Protests occurred across New York City, with students from NYU and Columbia University participating in walkouts.
Demonstrators at Washington Square Park chanted calls for 'intifada' and 'resistance'.
An NYU professor claimed the IDF killed some of its own citizens during the Oct. 7, 2023, attack.
